info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Streaming Subscriptions Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Streaming Subscriptions API enables users to effectively cancel existing streaming subscriptions for enhanced resource management. This API endpoint allows clients to seamlessly remove subscriptions that are no longer needed, thereby optimizing their content consumption. Typical consumers include application developers and operators managing subscription services in various platforms. By using this endpoint, businesses can ensure a streamlined process for handling subscription lifecycles, thus improving overall operational efficiency.

delete.description: This operation allows you to cancel an active subscription in the system. Once cancelled, the user will no longer have access to the subscription services.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an existing subscription. The payload must contain the necessary details to identify the subscription to be canceled.

200.description: The cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelReques.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling a subscription. It is expected to be a string containing relevant cancellation details.

status.description: Indicates if the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the cancellation process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelRespon.description: Schema representing the response structure for a successful cancellation operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information related to the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This can be useful for performance monitoring and debugging purposes.
